description:
Add or remove fields on an existing knowledge list schema.
Use this to evolve a list's schema — add new columns or remove unused ones.
Existing rows are not modified; new fields will be missing from old rows until updated.
Returns: { listKey, fieldCount }.

Requires write access when connected with OAuth.

addFields.description: Fields to add. Each field needs id (internal schema identifier), name (the rowData key used for storage and queries), type, and optionally label (human-friendly display; defaults to name if omitted). Fields with IDs already in the schema are skipped.

id.description: Internal field identifier used in schema operations such as removeFieldIds (snake_case recommended). Not used as a rowData key.

label.description: Human-friendly display label shown in the UI. Defaults to name if omitted.

name.description: Storage and query key — rowData is keyed by this value (e.g. rowData[field.name]). Must be unique within the list.

type.description: Field type: text | number | date | boolean | url | email | select

name.description: New display name for the list.

removeFieldIds.description: IDs of fields to remove from the schema. Does not modify existing row data.

userKeyField.description: Set or update the row identifier field. Pass a field name (e.g. "affinity_person_id") to enable automatic userKey derivation in kg.upsert-rows. Pass null or empty string to clear (revert to auto-UUID behaviour).

name: update_knowledge_list_schema
